title: gastrolychnis involucrata subsp. elatior
intro: Gastrolychnis involucrata subsp. elatior, commonly known as Wolf's Bane or Aconitum, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the Aconitum genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Gastrolychnis involucrata subsp. elatior include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although its use requires caution due to potential toxicity.
